reader.requirement: At --std 85 a SUPPRESS PRINTING inhibits presentation only of the report group named in the USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure in which the statement is written (any group type: CH, CF, detail), and only while that group is being processed; executed any other way (PERFORMed from the main program or from another group's USE procedure) it inhibits nothing.

edition-consulted.switches: SUPPRESS is reserved at every edition (row true,true,true,true)

reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb1186_suppress_named_group_85 covers two detail groups and a PERFORM from the main program and from another detail's USE procedure; control heading and control footing groups, a TERMINATE-time footing and the LINE-COUNTER effect are covered only by the probe

probes.expected: CH1's USE suppresses CH1 (both instances) and CF1's USE suppresses CF1 (break and TERMINATE); the SUPPRESS written in CH1's procedure but PERFORMed from DE1's procedure does not suppress DE1; LINE-COUNTER is not advanced for suppressed groups (1,2,3)

probes.printed: error COBOL1581: SUPPRESS PRINTING may appear only in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure
probes.expected: SUPPRESS outside a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure refused (XIII.4.6.3 SR1)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.6.4 GR1  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: BindSuppress fixes the group statically from the enclosing declarative, the emitter passes its index, and SuppressPrinting takes effect only when that index is the group whose hook RunBeforeReporting is running. No edition arm on this path.

refuter.evidence: Probe r6supp.cob (--std 85; two control levels K1 K2): SUPPRESS in the RH's USE suppressed the RH (line 1 blank, PH on line 2); a conditional SUPPRESS in CF2's USE suppressed only the first CF2 (GR2), and that suppressed CF2 processed no NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (no page advance, LINE-COUNTER 5, PC 1 after the break: GR3c/d) yet its sum was rolled forward into CF1 and reset (the next CF2 printed 005, CF1 printed 042 = 30+5+7: §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10b/10f); the unsuppressed second CF2 did advance the page; SUPPRESS in the RF's USE suppressed the RF at TERMINATE. Only the group named in each USE procedure was inhibited (DE and CF1 lines all present). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.6.4 GR1; OK §1985:XIII.4.6.4 GR3; OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10f.
